svg.title: One request through huddle., end to end
svg.desc: Sending a message: the chat screen and message controller add an optimistic bubble, the API client sends POST /message, and the NestJS backend runs request logger, JSON parser, request context, AuthGuard, ValidationPipe, controller, service and Prisma before MongoDB stores the message. The reply confirms the bubble, and the log line reaches the Inspector through GET /debug/logs.
svg.text: huddle.: one request, end to end (sending a message)
Numbers 1 to 8 are the order the backend runs each step. Any error in steps 4 to 8 goes to the exception filter instead.

g.text: NestJS API (container chatapp_api), steps in the order they run
